selection_process: Selection is through a Computer Based Test (CBT) only
followed by document verification. The notification does not mention a separate interview or the exam pattern.

The CBT will be conducted in English medium. The selection list will be prepared on the basis of the CBT result. Technical help from expert institutions will be taken with the State Government's permission. The selection list is valid for 6 months from the date of issue. A waiting list of up to 25% of the vacant posts (minimum one name) will be prepared for each category and is valid for 9 months. Candidates will be informed about document verification online through the department's portal

and absent candidates will be treated as ineligible. Selected candidates are subject to character verification (police verification). Selected candidates in the disability category will be examined by the District Medical Board for benchmark disability and functional requirements before joining. Appointment is subject to the final order of the Hon'ble Supreme Court in SLP (C) No. 019668/2022.
The contract appointment is for one year under Rule 4 of the Chhattisgarh Civil Services (Contract Appointment) Rules

and may be renewed or extended based on the Principal's and the Committee's recommendation after assessing performance (confidential report). Either party can end the contract with 3 months' notice or 3 months' salary in lieu of notice. The Committee can end the service without notice when the contract period ends. The appointment is entirely temporary
gives no claim for regular appointment or regularization
and will end automatically if regular recruitment is made against the post. Contract employees are governed by the Chhattisgarh Government Civil Services (Conduct) Rules
how_to_apply: Eligible candidates can apply for Chhattisgarh SAGES Recruitment 2026 through online mode only, between 01-10-2026 and 21-10-2026. Offline applications, whether sent by registered post or otherwise, are not valid. Follow the steps below:
Visit the official portal of the Directorate of Public Instruction, Chhattisgarh: https://eduportal.cg.nic.in.
Read the notification carefully and check the minimum educational qualification, TET requirement, age limit and domicile condition for the post you want.
Fill in the online application form with correct details and apply for the post (and subject) you are eligible for.
Submit the application on or before 21-10-2026 (up to midnight). Applications received after the stipulated date and time will not be considered.

Keep the required documents ready, including educational and TET certificates, the Chhattisgarh domicile (native resident) certificate, the permanent caste certificate (for SC/ST/OBC), the No Objection Certificate (if employed), and other certificates for reservation/relaxation claims. These are required for document verification.

A candidate can apply for only one subject in the Lecturer posts (more than one subject makes the application invalid). Similarly, one subject each can be chosen for Headmaster (Upper Primary)/Teacher, and for Headmaster (Primary)/Assistant Teacher. The PT Teacher, Librarian, Computer Teacher and Laboratory Assistant posts have one application each.
A candidate who meets the qualifications can submit a maximum of 7 separate applications, and separate exam dates/batches will be assigned accordingly.
Incomplete and erroneous applications will not be accepted, and no separate notice will be given for rejected applications.
SC/ST/OBC candidates must attach a permanent caste certificate from the competent authority. Married SC/ST women must provide a caste certificate showing their father's name.
Candidates must check the portal regularly for exam dates, document verification and other updates.

content_sections.heading: Chhattisgarh SAGES Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 1,812 contractual posts are notified across 33 districts of Chhattisgarh. The district-wise and category-wise breakup (with the 100-point reservation roster) is given in Annexure 'A' of the notification. For example, Raipur district has 141 vacancies. Reservation follows the Chhattisgarh Lok Seva (Reservation for SC, ST and Backward Classes) Act, 1994, and the 100-point roster as per General Administration Department directions, district-wise. 30% of posts are reserved for women (horizontal reservation) under the Chhattisgarh Civil Services (Special Provisions for Appointment of Women) Rules, 1997. Widows and divorced women are given preference. 7% of posts are reserved for persons with disabilities, and reservation for ex-servicemen is as per Government rules.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: All candidates must complete the minimum qualification on or before the last date of online application. Candidates must also have studied in the English medium from Class 6 up to the highest degree for the English medium posts. This English-medium condition does not apply to Lecturer and Teacher posts for Hindi and Sanskrit. The candidate must be a native (domicile) resident of Chhattisgarh and must attach a certificate issued by the competent authority. Candidates must pass the CG TET/CTET (Upper Primary level) for Teacher and Headmaster (Upper Primary) posts, and CG TET/CTET (Primary level) for Headmaster (Primary) and Assistant Teacher posts. Educational qualifications will be recognized as per the NCTE notifications issued from time to time and court judgments. Post-wise minimum qualifications are as per the Chhattisgarh Gazette dated 13-02-2026 and 22-09-2026. Contract teaching staff already working in SAGES cannot apply for the same post and can apply only for a higher post, and must give an affidavit that they have not applied for the same post. Government, corporation, board, bank and university employees must submit a No Objection Certificate from their employer. Master's degree with at least second class in the relevant subject from a recognized University/Institute, and B.Ed. (mandatory). Subject groups: Hindi; English; Sanskrit/Classics/Acharya; Physics/Electronics/Applied Physics/Nuclear Physics; Political Science/Public Administration; History/Ancient Indian History; Geography; Economics/Applied Economics/Business Economics; Mathematics/Applied Mathematics; Chemistry/Biochemistry; Biology (Botany/Zoology/Life Science/Genetics/Microbiology/Biotechnology/Molecular Biology/Plant Physiology, with Zoology or Botany at graduation); Commerce (including Accountancy, Cost Accounting or Financial Accountancy as a main subject); Social Science (Economics/Geography/Political Science/History). Headmaster, Primary School: Higher Secondary (12th) from a recognized board with at least 45% marks, and D.Ed/D.El.Ed. TET (Primary level) is mandatory.
